newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was at a standstill in the Panhandle area late Monday. Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested at the close.

Feedlots reported moderate inquiry from buyers. 21,800 head confirmed for the week to date which includes 20,100 formulated cattle to be shipped this week. The last established price was 63.00 on Friday. Today's packer bids were 62.00, asking prices mostly 63.00-64.00.
Confirmed: None Week Ago: 500 Year Ago: None
Week to date: 21,800 Week Ago: 21,300 Year Ago: 17,300
